words.gloss: to those who have no capital
to those who do not have

literal: To those who have no capital, there is no profit; to those who have no support that acts as a prop, there is no stability.
translation: Just as there is no profit for those who have no capital, there is no stability for those who lack the support of a strong prop.
modern: முதலீடு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு லாபம் இல்லை; அதுபோல, தாங்கிப் பிடிக்கும் தூண் போன்ற பெரியோரின் ஆதரவு இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு வாழ்வில் நிலைத்தன்மை இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet uses a simple financial analogy to explain the necessity of having wise and strong companions. Just as a merchant cannot earn any profit without an initial capital investment, a person cannot achieve stability or security in life without a strong supporting prop. Here, the supporting prop refers to the guidance and protection of wise elders. Without such a safeguard, one's position and endeavors will easily collapse.
